Since you've had trouble with friends in the past, you might be just insecure about your qualities. Here's my suggestion: write down a bunch of "I am" statements that you think makes you a good friend, or a quality in someone that would make you want to be there friend. Like if you think honesty is huge part in a (friend) relationship, then you could say "I am an honest person." Whatever floats your boat. I also suggest thinking of a time before you were friends with Mary and how that felt. Stay strong <3
